Synopsis:
    Overnight exchanges of drone and missile strikes between Ukraine and Russia. Russian air strikes hit a residential building in Kyiv, injuring eight. Ukrainian drones struck Russia's Tula region (2 killed, 3 injured), Saratov (Ozon logistics hub fire, no casualties), and Volgograd (2 injured, two residential buildings hit). Notably, Saratov hosts a Rosneft oil refinery and Volgograd hosts a major Lukoil refinery — both in proximity to strike activity, though neither is confirmed damaged. Russia resumed near-constant Kyiv attacks after a brief pause during U.S.-mediated ceasefire negotiations.
